loans.kindInstallmentHint: Fixed monthly payment, optionally with a “repaid by” target.
loans.kindDeadlineHint: No fixed payment but a deadline – e.g. a private loan due in March or “pay in 30 days”.
loans.spreadHint: Each month the required amount is planned so the debt is gone by the deadline.
loans.lumpHint: Until the due date a share is set aside each month; the full amount is paid on the due date (e.g. PayPal, Klarna or a private loan repaid in one sum).
loans.name: Name
loans.targetHint: Just a target: the app shows whether your payments are enough and how much is missing otherwise.

advice.baseline: Without further extra payments: debt-free in {{month}}, {{interest}} interest.
advice.baselineStuck: Without further extra payments, debt freedom is not foreseeable.

advice.nothingFree: Your available money is used up by the planned payments.

reserve.noItems: Add an item with a quarterly, half-yearly or yearly frequency.
